question: Should OpenClaw add a model-facing parent-only sub-agent send contract, and should it be a dedicated `sessions_send_parent` tool or a reserved `sessionKey: "parent"` target?
rationale: The change creates a new session authorization edge and model-facing tool semantic, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape or boundary rules without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add dedicated parent-only contract
options.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn metadata and rejects missing-parent, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, stale-parent, and auto-forwarding cases.

options.title: Defer to completion handoff
options.body: Keep mid-run child-to-parent sends unsupported and focus only on completion announce/session-yield orchestration.

options.title: Document broad opt-in only
options.body: Use existing allowlist and visibility configuration for trusted operators while accepting the larger authorization surface.

recommendation.title: Add dedicated parent-only contract
recommendation.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from spawn metadata and rejects missing-parent, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, stale-parent, and auto-forwarding cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current routing candidate for the session-tool policy, resolver, send, and visibility surfaces.
